senses.gloss: All the things under discussion.

(mythology, fantasy) One of a race of imaginary human-like beings, usually depicted as short and typically bearded males, who inhabit the inner parts of the earth and act as guardians of mines, mineral treasure, etc.; in modern fantasy literature and games, when distinguished from dwarves, gnomes are usually smaller than dwarves and more focused on engineering than mining.
A plant that is grown indoors in places such as a house or office for decorative purposes.

The branch of philosophy dealing with the study of knowledge; the theory of knowledge, asking such questions as "What is knowledge?", "How is knowledge acquired?", "What do people know?", "How do we know what we know?", "How do we know it is true?", and so on.
A critical or explanatory commentary or analysis.
Filled with wind; puffed up.
In a separate manner; not together; apart.
Into separate parts or pieces, often due to some violent action.
(transitive) To spoil; to ruin; to scathe; to damage.
Of or relating to an electronic version of a musical instrument that has an acoustic equivalent.
Electrical energy, as supplied by power stations or generators.
The state of being bored.
(literary, archaic) A feeling of discomfort or vexation caused by what one dislikes.
Abusive language.
A practice of communicating with one's God, or with some spiritual entity.
A prayer; (specifically), a private prayer by an individual said in addition to the five daily prayers of Islam.
(Catholicism) A specific form of short, solemn prayer said by the president of the liturgical celebration on behalf of the people.
an act of supplicating
(countable) A praying against evil; prayer that an evil may be removed or prevented; strong expression of disapprobation.
A prayer.
A deeply serious and somber prayer or entreaty.
large advertisement along side of highway
One’s native land; the place or country in which one dwells; the place where one’s ancestors dwell or dwelt.
The country that one regards as home.
An individual’s place of birth, childhood home, or place of main residence.
A room containing a number of beds (and often some other furniture and/or utilities) for sleeping, often applied to student and backpacker accommodation of this kind.
A large, round, semi-permanent tent with vertical walls and a conical roof, usually associated with Central Asia and Mongolia (where it is known as a ger).
Alert, awake; with one's mental faculties active.
Made aware of something.
To make sure or certain of something (usually some future event or condition).
To keep up; to preserve; to uphold (a state, condition etc.). [from 14th c.]
to give way
To keep erect; to support; to sustain; to keep from falling
To obtain or receive (something) from something else.
An agreement between parties; an arrangement.
A pleasing combination of elements, or arrangement of sounds.
A pact or binding agreement between two or more parties.
The re-establishment of friendly relations; conciliation, rapprochement.
A gathering of people lasting several days for the purpose of discussing or working on topics previously selected.
(law) A piece of legislation that has been properly authorized by a legislative body.
Something that is stated or stipulated as a condition of an agreement.
A mutual agreement, a covenant.
The action of looking; an attempt to see.
A fixed look; a look of eagerness, wonder, or admiration; a continued look of attention.
Specifically, the collection of hairs on the top and sides of the human head, growing from the scalp.
Physical appearance, visual impression.
A recording or medium of visual content, especially audiovisual content for playback; a motion picture, movie, film.
A mental picture of something not real or not present.
Relating to a doctorate.
The highest degree awarded by a university faculty.

(biology, demography) An excessive number of occupants (people, animals, plants, etc.) in a particular area; specifically, when the number of occupants exceeds the ability of that area to provide for them.
A small thrush, Turdus iliacus, native to Eurasia, with a white eye stripe and red under-wing feathers.
The continent that is south of Europe, east of the Atlantic Ocean, west of the Indian Ocean and north of Antarctica.
Of or pertaining to Africa.
An action, state of mind, or object one has an obligation to perform for another, adopt toward another, or give to another.
A sum of money or other property that a natural or legal person borrows from another with the condition that it be returned or repaid over time or at a later date (sometimes with interest).
An obligation, debt or responsibility owed to someone.
The amount owed.
Alternative spelling of incumbrance (“in law: interest attached to a title; dependent”).
Sky blue; resembling the clear blue colour of the unclouded sky.
Especially good or preferred.
The process or act of selecting.
picked; selected
In a progressive manner.

A vent or fissure on the surface of a planet (usually in a mountainous form) with a magma chamber attached to the mantle of a planet or moon, periodically erupting forth lava and volcanic gases onto the surface.
(Roman god) The god of volcanoes and fire, especially the forge, also the patron of all craftsmen, especially blacksmiths. The Roman counterpart of Hephaestus.
Capable of being conceived or imagined.
The cardinal number immediately following fifty-eight and preceding sixty.
Any explosive substance.
To rest in a state of reduced consciousness.
(informal, chiefly, UK) To sleep; often with the connotation of a temporary or charitable situation, or one borne out of necessity.
(intransitive, British, slang) To sleep, especially in the open or in a derelict building because one is homeless.
Displaying or feeling anger.
Easily provoked to outbursts of anger; irritable.
uncooked
Callous and unsentimental. (of a person, especially a detective)
Moisture in the air that settles on plants, etc in the morning or evening, resulting in drops.
Conspicuous, exceptional, outstanding; usually in a negative sense.
Raw and not cooked, especially of something that should be, or is sometimes cooked.
Bestial; lacking human sensibility
The pigmented vascular layer of the eyeball between the retina and the sclera.
Being the winner in a contest, struggle, war, etc.
The official rules and guidelines for heads of state and other dignitaries, governing accepted behaviour in relations with other diplomatic representatives or over affairs of state.
A large island in northwestern Europe.
Pertaining to or originating from Ireland or the Irish people.
Ability, skill, competence.
The ordinal form of the number sixty-eight, describing a person or thing in position number 68 of a sequence.
To apply violent force to someone or something.
(transitive) To cause or commit an outrage upon; to treat with violence or abuse.
Senses relating to moving from a higher to a lower position.
(intransitive) To attack suddenly by leaping.
(intransitive) To increase, to rise
To attack with harsh words or violent force.
(transitive, obsolete) To assault, attack.
To assault aggressively.
A state of the United States. Capital: Tallahassee. Largest city: Jacksonville.
Sexual intercourse by a married person with someone other than their spouse. See more synonyms at Thesaurus:cuckoldry
Sexual intercourse by people who are not married to each other, or which is considered illicit in another way.
(intransitive) To engage in fornication.
A mixture prepared in such a way.
land or marine reptile with a shell

Any of various land-dwelling reptiles, of the family Testudinidae (chiefly Canada, US) or the order Testudines (chiefly UK, Australia, New Zealand, Ireland, South Africa, India), whose body is enclosed in a shell (carapace plus plastron). The animal can withdraw its head and four legs partially into the shell, providing some protection from predators.
A city in Azerbaijan.
The ordinal form of the number ninety-two, describing a person or thing in position number 92 of a sequence.
The transfer of a company or organization from government to private ownership and control.
A musical instrument that has multiple pipes which play when a key is pressed (the pipe organ), or an electronic instrument designed to replicate such.
A telecommunications facilitator whose job is to connect or otherwise assist callers.
Contrary to logic; lacking sense or sound reasoning.
Not conscionable; unscrupulous and lacking principles or conscience.
A type of incense obtained from the Boswellia thurifera tree.
A tool used to carry the woof back and forth between the warp threads on a loom.
Of, belonging to, or relating to Canada, its culture, or people.
The act or process of irrigating, or the state of being irrigated; especially, the operation of causing water to flow over lands, for nourishing plants.
A group of similar things, either growing together, or in a cluster or clump, usually fastened together.
bunch of grapes
Any of several woody climbing vines, of the genus Wisteria, native to the East Asian countries of China, Korea, and Japan and the eastern United States.
(botany) An indeterminate inflorescence in which the flowers are arranged along a single central axis.
disorder of the immune system
(countable, medicine) Extreme sensitivity to a food or drug; of a food that is generally considered edible, an individual inability to digest it.
An anthology of previously released material linked together by theme or author, especially in book form.
A single element of a magician's (or any variety entertainer's) act; a magic trick.
a departure from the main subject in speech or writing
A form of musical notation indicating fingering rather than the pitch of notes, commonly used for stringed instruments.
Not conclusive, not leading to a conclusion.
Without sense; absurd.
In an incoherent manner.
A living organism (originally a plant) produced asexually from a single ancestor, to which it is genetically identical.
Without consideration, awareness or sound judgement
(engineering) penetration of a physical barrier
A local custom or law of a settlement or district.
To circle or revolve around another object or position.
Masculine in an overly assertive or aggressive way. Very masculine.
The notch at the rear of an arrow that fits on the bowstring.
A bit shift.
Pleasant, charismatic.
Having appeal; attractive.
present participle and gerund of allure
Commanding the attention of spectators.
Teasing; tempting, especially that which is beyond reach.
That is pleasing to the sense of taste; appetizing; that makes one salivate.
Attractive; visually pleasing; good-looking.
A city in Andalusia, Spain.
One of the four suits of playing cards, marked with the symbol ♠.
An orderly combination of related parts.
A plan, drawing, sketch or outline to show the function or operation of something, or to show the relationships between the parts of a whole.
An outline or image universally applicable to a general conception, under which it is likely to be presented to the mind (for example, a body schema).
A simplified line drawing used by scientists, engineers, technologists and others to illustrate a system at an abstract level. Schematic drawings often use standard symbols for clarity.
(book of the bible) a book of the Old Testament of Bible, and of the Tanakh

(literary) Used, especially at a parting, to express the wish that the outcome of a person's actions be positive for them; typically said to someone who is about to start a journey or a daring endeavour.
An activity that is entertaining or amusing, such as dancing, gunning, or fishing.
A word used to join other words, phrases, or clauses together into sentences. (The specific conjunction used shows how the two joined parts are related semantically.)
(astronomy) The conjunction of two celestial objects.
Fermentation.

Any of many anaerobic biochemical reactions in which an enzyme (or several enzymes produced by a microorganism) catalyses the conversion of one substance into another; especially the conversion (using yeast) of sugars to alcohol or acetic acid with the evolution of carbon dioxide
An island and country in the Caribbean.
A city in the West Bank, Palestine.
The indigenous language of the Manchu people, spoken in Manchuria.
A type of word that refers anaphorically to a noun or noun phrase, but which cannot ordinarily be preceded by a determiner and rarely takes an attributive adjective.
Of, relating to, or providing a description.
To harvest a fruit or vegetable for consumption by removing it from the plant to which it is attached; to harvest an entire plant by removing it from the ground.
A person who makes, repairs, or alters clothes professionally, especially suits and men's clothing.

(equestrian) A riding or driving bit for a horse that has rein action which amplifies the pressure in the mouth by leverage advantage placing pressure on the poll via the crown piece of the bridle and chin groove via a curb chain.
A strap or rope attached to a bridle or bit, used to control a horse, other animal or young child.
The headgear with which a horse is directed and which carries a bit and reins.
The part of a bridle that fits over a horse's head and supports other elements.
wife's brother's wife

One's spouse's sister-in-law, especially one's husband's brother's wife, one's brother's wife in relation to the spouses of his siblings; either of two (or more) women who are married to brothers, in relation to the other.
A person or thing that emulates.
A case of translucent or transparent material made to protect a flame, or light, used to illuminate its surroundings.
A tank, often made of glass, for keeping live fish or other aquatic animals.
(uncountable) The quality of being fit or suitable to effect some desired end or the purpose intended; suitability for particular circumstance or situation.
The practice of taking advantage of any situations or people to achieve an end, often with no regard for principles or consequences.
Loud; shrill, piercing, high-pitched; rough-sounding.
Unhappiness or discontent.
A confused disordered jumble of things.
To lift, move, or collect with a scoop or as though with a scoop.
To move materials with a shovel.
To induce someone or something to leave.
A tool in the form of a foot on which an item of footwear (such as a boot or shoe) is placed for shaping while it is being manufactured or repaired.
coal
(ambitransitive) To replace or enhance human labor with machines.
The practise of managing and hiring out prostitutes.
An offer of illicit sex with a third party.
In an infinite manner; as of anything growing without bounds; endlessly.
A tool used for cutting thin material, consisting of two crossing blades attached at a pivot point in such a way that the blades slide across each other when the handles are closed.
A low-pitched hum or buzz.
The act of making anything round, as the lips in pronouncing some vowels.
A person, in a church, cinema etc., who escorts people to their seats.
A church official who looks after a church building and its graveyard and may act as a gravedigger and bell ringer.
The person who maintains the sacristy and the sacred objects it contains.
